A curator asked an AI curation assistant this request about one publication:
"What transgenic flies are used in the publication?"

The assistant extracted the records below. Each record lists its saved values, the exact sentences quoted from the paper as evidence, and, where a database validator was run, the validator's answer.

Record R1 (generic_reagent_candidate):
  label: "crb 11A22 FRT mutant stock and eye mosaics"
  rationale: "The stock is explicitly used to generate mutant eyes and must be distinguished from the mosaic-generation male stock."
  reagent_type: "Drosophila FRT mutant stock"
  source_label: "w; FRT82B crb 11A22 /TM6B"
  classification_notes: ["An explicitly used mutant fly stock fits the reagent-candidate class.", "Retained as a mutant partner in the eyFLP/FRT crosses, not as an independently demonstrated crb transgene."]
  evidence E1 (page 8, Methods): "Genetic eye mosaics consisting of large mutant patches of crb 11A22 and crb 8F105 were generated by crossing yweyFLP;;FRT82B w + cl3R3/TM6B males [ 58] to w; FRT82B crb 11A22 /TM6B and w*; FRT82B crb 8F105 /TM6B respectively."
  validator answer R1V1 (gene_validator, field gene): status failed
  validator answer R1V2 (gene_validator, field gene): status resolved; resolved values {"curie": "FB:FBgn0259685"}; explanation "Exact symbol match."

Record R2 (generic_reagent_candidate):
  label: "eyFLP/FRT mosaic-generation male stock"
  rationale: "This is the reported mosaic-generation stock most directly relevant to the request for transgenic flies."
  reagent_type: "Drosophila mosaic-generation stock"
  source_label: "yweyFLP;;FRT82B w + cl3R3/TM6B"
  classification_notes: ["An explicitly used fly stock fits the reagent-candidate class.", "Identify the eyFLP/FRT genetic machinery from the stated genotype; do not invent insertion names or stock identifiers."]
  evidence E2 (page 8, Methods): "Genetic eye mosaics consisting of large mutant patches of crb 11A22 and crb 8F105 were generated by crossing yweyFLP;;FRT82B w + cl3R3/TM6B males [ 58] to w; FRT82B crb 11A22 /TM6B and w*; FRT82B crb 8F105 /TM6B respectively."

Record R3 (generic_reagent_candidate):
  label: "crb 8F105 FRT mutant stock and eye mosaics"
  rationale: "The stock is explicitly used to generate mutant eyes and must be distinguished from the mosaic-generation male stock."
  reagent_type: "Drosophila FRT mutant stock"
  source_label: "w*; FRT82B crb 8F105 /TM6B"
  classification_notes: ["An explicitly used mutant fly stock fits the reagent-candidate class.", "Retained as a mutant partner in the eyFLP/FRT crosses, not as an independently demonstrated crb transgene."]
  evidence E3 (page 8, Methods): "Genetic eye mosaics consisting of large mutant patches of crb 11A22 and crb 8F105 were generated by crossing yweyFLP;;FRT82B w + cl3R3/TM6B males [ 58] to w; FRT82B crb 11A22 /TM6B and w*; FRT82B crb 8F105 /TM6B respectively."

Record R4 (generic_reagent_candidate):
  label: "white (w) white-eyed genetic control"
  rationale: "The genetic control must be listed separately to avoid interpreting every non-wild-type fly as transgenic."
  reagent_type: "Drosophila genetic control"
  source_label: "white ( w )"
  classification_notes: ["An explicitly used genetic-control fly reagent fits the reagent-candidate class.", "The white mutation alone does not establish transgenic status."]
  evidence E4 (page 8, Methods): "The genetic control were white-eyed flies of the genotype white ( w )."

Record R5 (generic_reagent_candidate):
  label: "crb p13A / crb p13A9 isoform mutant"
  rationale: "This is the third experimental crb mutant and clarifies which flies should not automatically be counted as transgenic."
  reagent_type: "Drosophila isoform mutant"
  source_label: "crb p13A"
  classification_notes: ["An explicitly used mutant fly reagent fits the reagent-candidate class.", "Retained separately from eyFLP/FRT stocks; neither the allele name nor the isoform lesion establishes transgenic status."]
  evidence E5 (page 8, Methods): "The following crb alleles were used: crb 11A22 [ 57] crb 8F105 , [ 57] crb p13A [ 42] ."
  evidence E6 (page 4, Results and Discussion): "Linking Phenotype to Genotype through Molecular Abundance of Eye Proteins
We next applied MS Western to quantify proteins of eyes from flies with mutated crumbs ( crb ).

In contrast, crb p13A9 , which contains a mutation that eliminates only one of three isoforms, the Crb\_C isoform, induces no apparent morphological abnormalities [42] (Figure 5D)."

Record R6 (generic_reagent_candidate):
  label: "Oregon R wild-type stock"
  rationale: "The wild-type comparator clarifies the inventory of flies used without misclassifying controls as transgenic."
  reagent_type: "Drosophila wild-type stock"
  source_label: "Oregon R"
  classification_notes: ["An explicitly used wild-type fly stock fits the reagent-candidate class.", "Included separately as the requested distinction from transgenic machinery and mutant stocks."]
  evidence E7 (page 8, Methods): "[14,42] Oregon R was the wild-type strain of choice."
